new_start: original cycle start >=2024-06-01; first TRUE from original start to original end
carryin: keep original start; describe first research-domain observation, do not infer original first recognition or full-cycle lag
lag: number of source common trading sessions after original start to first TRUE; no nearest-price selection
remaining: original end index close / signal-day index close -1 retrospective only
switch: every state transition; distinguish0to1/-1to1; FALSE is not actual account exit
phases: unchanged existing five-industry phase anchors; first TRUE in upward phase and first FALSE in downward phase; not optimized
